incident-bot: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx rate on hosted-redwood-api detected -> paging eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.in/incident/2182100000 :rotating_light:

Alex (oncall): Ack. I'm looking. Seeing a spike in 502/504s from the model gateway, errors originate ~12:10 UTC. Will dump recent logs and check upstream health.

Priya SRE: I can confirm upstream provider (model-gateway-east) showing timeouts. Logs show repeated `upstream timed out` and `502 Bad Gateway` from proxy. Sample:

```
2026-07-04T12:11:02Z host=gw-east request_id=abc123 status=502 msg="upstream timed out after 30s" backend=model-gateway-east
2026-07-04T12:11:08Z host=gw-east request_id=abc129 status=504 msg="gateway read timeout" backend=model-gateway-east
```

Marco Platform: I'm kicking a soft failover to model-gateway-west for non-Dedicated tenants and enabling short-circuit fallback to the smaller lm-small model for long-running calls. Pushing routing change now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by Marco Platform -> routing/service:gateway-router v2026.07.04-1432

Jen Support: Getting customer reports (tier:startup) of failed generation calls, ~50 customer error tickets in last 15m. Some enterprise customers seeing increased latency but no data loss.

Alex (oncall): Good. Priya, can you scope if this is provider-side (their incident) vs our client-side config? Prioritizing mitigation + customer comms. I'll prepare a short status.

Priya SRE: Early signal points to provider-side degradation. All backends in eu-west/1 to gw-east have high error rates, provider status page shows degraded performance. I've opened a ticket with provider and requested ETA.

Marco Platform: Routing change applied. Confirming traffic now split 20/80 west/east for traffic to the affected model family. Also temporarily increased request timeout from 30s -> 35s while provider recovers.

Alex (oncall): Noted. Can someone add a temporary tweak to alerts so we don't page on transient provider blips? We're getting multiple noisy pages. Proposing: raise PRD 5xx page threshold and add grouping by backend.

Priya SRE: Agreed. Current alert is too aggressive:

```
alert: High5xxRate
expr: rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m]) > 0.005
for: 1m
```

This paged immediately. Propose updating to:

```
# suggested rule
alert: High5xxRate
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (backend, cluster) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway"}[5m])) by (backend, cluster) > 0.01
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```

This requires the error fraction to be >1% sustained across 5m per backend to page. Also add a separate warning label for 0.5-1% (no page).

Jen Support: Please also add a small dashboard tile for customer-visible 5xx so support can triage without paging SRE. Put it on the Support Ops screen.

Marco Platform: I'll add the dashboard. Also propose adding alert grouping to avoid one per-tenant pager storms: set `group_by: backend` in the alertmanager route and route per-backend -> rotate oncall.

Alex (oncall): Good plan. Noah (night-oncall) I'll hand off in 10m. Summary for handoff: provider degraded causing gateway 5xx; temporary routing to west + lm-small fallback applied; increased timeout; customer impact moderate (errors + latency); mitigation in place; proposed alert rule change + dashboard tile + runbook edit.

Noah (night-oncall): I'll take it. Can you drop the checklist in the incident doc and add who owns the postmortem?

Priya SRE: I'll own the alert PR. Creating branch and PR now. PR will contain new rule + test alerts in staging and updated alertmanager grouping.

Priya SRE: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/3424 -> includes: updated `High5xxRate` rule, new `High5xxWarning` (severity: warning), and grouping changes. Will run canary deploy to prod.

Alex (oncall): Thanks. Marco, can you create the dashboard tile and add to Support Ops as Jen requested?

Marco Platform: Yep. Dashboard tile created -> https://grafana.redwood/d/reds/5xx-overview?panelId=12. Added to Support Ops board.

Jen Support: Noted. I'll update the support triage doc with the dashboard link and put a canned response for customers experiencing 502/504 while we liaise with provider.

Priya SRE: After canary, I'm seeing alert noise drop. Backend error fraction for gw-east peaked ~2.8% and is back down to ~0.4% after routing change. No additional pages in last 12m.

Alex (oncall): OK closing active pager. Follow-ups:
- Priya: merge PR #3424 and monitor for next 24h.
- Marco: add a short note in runbook about routing fallback and add a k8s job to automate fallback on upstream timeout spikes.
- Jen: update support triage + send status update to affected customers (template in incident doc).
- Noah: lead the postmortem tomorrow local 10:00 PT in #incidents, owner = Priya.

Noah (night-oncall): Acknowledged. I'll grab logs and metrics and prep slides.

Alex (oncall): Thanks team. I'll post a short incident summary to #incidents once Priya confirms PR merged. :thumbsup:
